name: Import Figma assets
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths: ["sources/figma-assets.json", ".github/workflows/figma-assets.yml"]
  workflow_dispatch:
permissions:
  contents: write
concurrency:
  group: figma-assets
  cancel-in-progress: false
jobs:
  import:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Download original Figma assets
        run: |
          python3 - <<'PY'
          import json, pathlib, subprocess, hashlib
          manifest = pathlib.Path('sources/figma-assets.json')
          if not manifest.exists():
              print('Waiting for asset manifest.'); raise SystemExit(0)
          records = json.loads(manifest.read_text())
          for item in records:
              dest = pathlib.Path(item['path'])
              if not str(dest).startswith('public/assets/') or '..' in dest.parts:
                  raise ValueError('Invalid asset path')
              if not item['url'].startswith('https://www.figma.com/api/mcp/asset/'):
                  raise ValueError('Invalid asset source')
              if dest.exists() and dest.stat().st_size > 0:
                  continue
              dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
              subprocess.run(['curl', '-fL', '--retry', '3', '--max-time', '60', item['url'], '-o', str(dest)], check=True)
              if dest.stat().st_size < 30:
                  raise ValueError('Empty asset: ' + str(dest))
          hashes = {item['path']: hashlib.sha256(pathlib.Path(item['path']).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for item in records}
          pathlib.Path('sources/asset-hashes.json').write_text(json.dumps(hashes, indent=2) + '\n')
          PY
      - name: Commit permanent local assets
        run: |
          if [ ! -d public/assets ]; then exit 0; fi
          git config user.name 'github-actions[bot]'
          git config user.email '41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com'
          git add public/assets sources/asset-hashes.json
          if ! git diff --cached --quiet; then
            git commit -m 'assets: vendor original Figma imagery and SVGs'
            git pull --rebase origin main
            git push origin HEAD:main
          fi
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: ${{ hashFiles('public/assets/**') != '' }}
        with:
          name: figma-original-assets
          path: public/assets/
          retention-days: 3
